name: Dry Ginger
methodDescription: Lifted from the soil. Boiled briefly. Sun-dried until it loses four-fifths of its weight.
specimenCopy: What enters the ground as a wet root leaves as something different. The drying doesn't just remove water — it concentrates and transforms the resins that give ginger its heat. Dry ginger is not fresh ginger aged. It's a separate material.

sensoryProfile.aroma: Earthy, warm ginger oil, pungent citrus zest
sensoryProfile.flavor: Sharp, radiating spice, sweet herbal undertones, intense heat
